title: Linearity in the second argument
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb C$ and $c\in\mathbb C$. The probability-weighted complex inner product satisfies $\langle f,cg\rangle_p=c\langle f,g\rangle_p$, where $\langle f,g\rangle_p=\sum_{x\in\Omega}p(x)\overline{f(x)}g(x)$.
